Chapter 1: Oracle Cave

Young Roric has been snatched from his family's farm, and the trail leads to the Oracle Cave beneath the Iron Forest — a black warren where locals leave offerings to an ancient being said to know every secret of the Misty Vale. The brigands who took the boy were themselves ambushed by giant spiders, and now Roric hangs in a cocoon in the lair of Saak'shal, the vast she-spider people call the Oracle. To reach her, the heroes must squeeze through crushing passages, cross a freezing underground river, evade the eel beast of the lake, and survive swarms of spiderlings and her elder offspring. Saak'shal would rather bargain than fight: slay Agra's orc patrol in the keep, and she will give up the boy and the statuette piece.
